Package org.geysermc.paletter.vanilla

Class BedrockItemVariants

java.lang.Object
org.geysermc.paletter.vanilla.BedrockItemVariants
public final class BedrockItemVariants extends Object
The named aux variants of Bedrock 26.60, the newest bundled release, of the items BedrockItems.ARROW, BedrockItems.BANNER, BedrockItems.BED, BedrockItems.LINGERING_POTION, BedrockItems.POTION, BedrockItems.SPLASH_POTION. The names are BDS's own spellings, taken from the Script API (the potion effect id, the localization key of the stack). Every constant is the very BedrockItemVariant of type.variant(aux). Referencing them loads nothing.

Constants are added when Bedrock adds variants (binary compatible). A variant Bedrock removes keeps its constant, deprecated: type.variant(aux) is then a plain variant, equal to the constant. A name BDS changes stays as a deprecated alias of the new one.

@since is the Paletter version that added a constant, only written if newer than the class. The names come from BDS dumps of the newest builds only, so a variant says nothing of the Bedrock release it is first in: it may be older than the dumps. @SincePreview marks variants only the bundled Bedrock preview has: without previews loaded (paletter.previews) its type has no such variant, so type.variant(aux) is a plain variant and the constant stays a plain key. The mark goes when a release has it; the constant goes if a newer preview drops it.

Since:
1.0.0
